scripts.server:stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Host ('Stopped server PID ' + $p) } else { Write-Host 'No server process on port 3001' }"
scripts.server:restart: npm run server:stop && npm run dev:server
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.import:npc-all: npm run import:npc-catalog && npm run import:npc-visuals && npm run import:npc-heads
scripts.test:smoke: vitest run tests/shared/joinSession.test.ts tests/shared/characterDeathState.test.ts tests/game/progressPersistGuard.test.ts tests/game/characterProgressIsolation.test.ts tests/game/characterProgressApply.test.ts tests/game/imperiumNpcCatalog.test.ts tests/game/imperiumNpcVisuals.test.ts tests/scenes/multiplayerJoinPayload.test.ts
